aggregation.currency: one uppercase three-letter code per period and snapshot
aggregation.tax: sum pos.fiscal_tax_details exactly once by governed tax classification; mixed document-level and line-level representation for one classification is prohibited
aggregation.statutory: project Senior Citizen and PWD from pos.fiscal_document_applied_statutory_facts; do not add duplicate privilege-detail amounts
aggregation.commercialDiscount: sum governed coupon and promotional privilege-detail classifications separately
aggregation.tenders: sum pos.fiscal_tenders once by governed reporting tender classification
aggregation.voids: exclude voided documents from recorded sales and report their original final fiscal amount as a non-negative void total in the period containing the committed void
aggregation.reprints: presentation events only; never documents or sales
aggregation.antiDoubleCount: detail, total, statutory, and presentation representations are reconciliation peers and must never be added twice

xReading.identity: one immutable snapshot per Site POS Server operation key
xReading.exactReplay: same operation key and semantic hash returns the original snapshot
xReading.conflict: same operation key and different semantic hash conflicts
xReading.newObservation: a new operation key may create another snapshot for the same open period

zReading.closeIdentity: one Z snapshot per fiscal reporting period
zReading.exactReplay: same operation key and semantic hash returns the original committed Z snapshot
zReading.conflict: same operation key with changed semantics or a second close identity conflicts

databaseInvariants: operation key is unique within one Site POS Server
one report snapshot exists per report request
one Z snapshot exists per fiscal reporting period
report number is unique within one fiscal identity
one BIR profile summary exists per governing Z snapshot
child classification rows are unique within one report
all report and child currencies equal the parent report currency
period end is strictly greater than period start
resulting GTA equals previous GTA plus current period amount
resulting Z counter equals previous Z counter plus one
committed snapshots and children reject UPDATE and DELETE
closed periods reject UPDATE and DELETE
parent deletion cannot cascade away fiscal reporting evidence
externalComplianceDependencies: BIR Sales Summary final formula and layout
Annex E form and profile version
refund, return, and adjustment reporting treatment
signature, retention, submission, and external filename rules
